title: Naan for breadmaker
preamble:
Ingredients:-
½
teaspoon Yeast
3
cups Flour
½
teaspoon Sugar
½
teaspoon Salt
2
tablespoon Butter
¾
cup Yogurt
½
cup Water
4
tablespoons Butter
4
tablespoons Onions,chopped

½

4
tablespoons Butter
4
tablespoons Onions,chopped

Method:-
Make sure your oven is well preheated to maximum it will go to.
Use dough cycle on machine.
Remove dough from machine and divide into 12 parts.
Roll each part into a small circle (about 8" diameter) and place on greased pizza or other baking pan.
Brush top of each one with melted butter and press finely chopped onion into dough.
Bake 10-15 minutes until puffy and brown.
